name: Doorkeepers
overview: Scripture highlights the humble yet significant role of doorkeepers both in sacred and royal settings. Psalm 84:10 expresses a deep spiritual longing to serve even as a doorkeeper in God's house, valuing proximity to Him above worldly pleasures. The imagery of doors in John 10:1 underscores the importance of rightful access and protection, contrasting the true gatekeeper with those who enter unlawfully. Additionally, John 18:17 shows the practical responsibility of doorkeepers in palaces, guarding entrances and discerning those who seek entry, illustrating their role in maintaining order and security.
